meta.attribution: Melodic data derived from note-level transcriptions in the Weimar Jazz Database. Licks are selected either along the transcribers' own phrase boundaries (tagged with the song-form section they occur in) or by detecting real ii-V/ii-V-I/V-I harmonic motion in the actual chord changes, with the original tune, performer, and bar location cited alongside each one.
meta.citation: Pfleiderer, M., Frieler, K., Abesser, J., Zaddach, W.-G., Burkhart, B. (Eds.) (2017). Inside the Jazzomat - New Perspectives for Jazz Research. Schott Campus.
meta.note: DEMO SUBSET (2 per performer) for local testing. Run extract_licks.py yourself to generate the full set.
